thought: The sets are tailored for a 3v3 singles format with limited EVs, maximizing key stats with 32/32/2 spreads and synergistic items. Gholdengo and Volcarona serve as special setup sweepers with recovery and coverage, while Dragonite and Garchomp provide physical setup and priority. Rotom-Wash acts as a bulky pivot with Will-O-Wisp and Pain Split, and Kingambit cleans late-game with boosted Sucker Punch. Items are chosen to avoid Clause conflicts and enhance each role: Spell Tag boosts Gholdengo's Ghost STAB, Dragoninite enables Mega Dragonite, Life Orb powers Garchomp, Charti Berry protects Volcarona from Rock moves, Leftovers gives Rotom longevity, and Black Glasses amplifies Kingambit's Dark moves.
